description: This Java class defines CreateNewModuleTask, which extends ModuleProvidingTask. It handles creating a new module within an IntelliJ IDEA project, setting up its content root, adding Android facets if necessary, and configuring the Android SDK platform.

classes.name: CreateNewModuleTask
classes.description: A class that creates and configures a new module in an IntelliJ IDEA project, including setting up Android facets and SDK.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Creates a new module, adds content root, sets up Android facet and SDK, returns an exception if any.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns a descriptive title for the task, including module name and content root path.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module, derived from the content root's name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on content root and project.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on project and content root.

methods.name: getContentRoot
methods.description: Returns the VirtualFile representing the content root.
